Title: Azure Automation is now available in the USGov Arizona region

Body.Content:
Azure Automation is now available in the USGov Arizona region.

Create, monitor, deploy, and maintain resources in your Azure, on-premises, and third-party cloud environments using highly scalable and reliable process automation, patching through update management and state configuration engines.

To learn more and get started with a free trial, read the Azure Automation overview.
